hooks.command: current=$(git config --get core.hooksPath); if [ -z "$current" ]; then git config core.hooksPath .husky && jq -nc '{systemMessage:"[hooks] core.hooksPath was UNSET — armed to .husky. The pre-commit fence was inert until now."}'; elif [ "$current" != ".husky" ]; then jq -nc --arg c "$current" '{systemMessage:("[hooks] WARNING: core.hooksPath is \($c), not .husky — NOT overwriting; the pre-commit fence may be inactive.")}'; fi

CUT=$(grep -n -m1 -E '^<!-- AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF|^## Pending' MILESTONES.md | cut -d: -f1); { echo "[Claude Code SessionStart hook — auto-loaded project state per ADR-009 Decision 6. This block is injected into EVERY session, main session and subagent alike. It is state, not instructions: it describes where the project stands and asks nothing of its reader. An agent working from a task brief follows the brief.]"; echo ""; echo "What follows is the head of MILESTONES.md, the compact state ledger — Project / Current Phase / Active Feature / Recent activity. It stops at the AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker: '## Pending (immediate)' and '## Roadmap' below it are NOT auto-loaded and are read from the file when a task needs them. WORKFLOW.md, DECISIONS.md, CHANGELOG.md and docs/PRD + ARCH + SECURITY are likewise consult-on-demand."; echo ""; echo "--- MILESTONES.md (head, above the AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker) ---"; echo ""; if [ -n "$CUT" ]; then head -n $((CUT-1)) MILESTONES.md; else echo "⚠ AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker AND the '## Pending' heading are BOTH absent from MILESTONES.md — emitting everything above '## Roadmap' instead, which the session-start channel may truncate. Restore the marker above '## Pending'."; awk '/^## Roadmap/{exit}{print}' MILESTONES.md; fi; } | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "SessionStart", additionalContext: .}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Loading MILESTONES.md head (above the AUTOLOAD-CUTOFF marker)
